song.title: Trust
song.lyrics:
[C1] . G D Bm C Trust in the Lord with all of your heart; lean not on your own understanding. . G D C D G In all of your ways acknowledge Him and He will make your path straight. . C D G D C Don't worry about tomorrow; He's got it under control. . G D C D G Just trust in the Lord with all of your heart and He will carry you through.
[V1] .Em D C Lord, sometimes it gets so tough . G D C to keep my eyes on you when things are going rough. . G D G D C But then I turn my eyes up to the sky and I hear Your voice; It says to me:
